description:
Ideal for investors is this three bedroom property located in an ever popular residential area in Newton Aycliffe. Always in demand for rental purposes, this spacious property requires some cosmetic updating and is also close to local amenities and schools.

ENTRANCE HALL Double glazed front door, radiator and stairs to the first floor.

DOWNSTAIRS W/C With sink and toilet.

LIVING ROOM 17' 0" x 9' 9" (5.20m x 2.98m) Double glazed window and two radiators.

KITCHEN 11' 10" x 13' 3" (3.63m x 4.04m) Double glazed window and rear door, radiator, fitted with wall and floor fitted units, space for appliances and space for freestanding cooker.

BEDROOM ONE 9' 5" x 14' 9" (2.89m x 4.50m) Double glazed window and radiator.

BEDROOM TWO 10' 11" x 11' 6" (3.34m x 3.51m) Double glazed window, radiator and loft access.

BEDROOM THREE 10' 7" x 11' 6" (3.23m x 3.51m) Double glazed window and radiator.

BATHROOM Double glazed window, radiator and fitted with white suite with bath, sink and toilet.

EXTERNALLY Enclosed yard area to rear of property.

GENERAL INFORMATION Council Tax - Band A Please note all measurements including floorplans are approximate only.
